import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_prefixscan_b()
    return nothing
end

function prefixscan_b(loss, lossb, y, yb, x, xb, n)
    y[1] = x[1]
    for i_k = 2:n
        y[i_k] = y[i_k - 1] + x[i_k]
    end
    for i_j = 1:n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + y[i_j]
    end
    for i_j = n:-1:1
        yb[i_j] = yb[i_j] + lossb[1]
    end
    for i_k = n:-1:2
        yb[i_k - 1] = yb[i_k - 1] + yb[i_k]
        xb[i_k] = xb[i_k] + yb[i_k]
        yb[i_k] = 0.0
    end
    xb[1] = xb[1] + yb[1]
    yb[1] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_prefixscan_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function prefixscan_b_cuda(loss, lossb, y, yb, x, xb, n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            y[1] = x[1]
        end
    for i_k = 2:n
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                y[i_k] = y[i_k - 1] + x[i_k]
            end
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_prefixscan_b_1!(loss, n, y)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_prefixscan_b_2!(lossb, n, yb)
    for i_k = n:-1:2
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                yb[i_k - 1] = yb[i_k - 1] + yb[i_k]
                xb[i_k] = xb[i_k] + yb[i_k]
                yb[i_k] = 0.0
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            xb[1] = xb[1] + yb[1]
            yb[1] = 0.0
        end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_prefixscan_b_1!(loss, n, y)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += y[i_j]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_prefixscan_b_2!(lossb, n, yb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    yb[i_j] = yb[i_j] + lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

n = 3
__base_loss = Float64[0.5702742818910688, 0.9955882668187228, 0.13352078305729997, 0.43116469770593224]

__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.19364097220138077, 1.3341523409288987, 1.5949696782704272, -0.7895586909603973], Float64[-1.4894215815699445, 0.5702742818910688, 0.9955882668187228, 0.13352078305729997], Float64[1.2188505588178802, -1.2163601827790058, -0.19376902000869958, 0.17239641732903085]]
__seed_y = [Float64[-1.4503755790312343, -0.3706727681595821, -0.13577585330936393, 1.538427897896642], Float64[0.43116469770593224, -0.5447585962230655, 0.11213204081925927, -0.8104913349671281], Float64[0.012739225781032693, -0.04461794883683381, 0.08425582835101351, -0.4290327988848478]]
__seed_x = [Float64[-0.13067942409865124, 0.36956871271729724, 0.34983482544566324, -0.5188566709564298], Float64[-0.6884360887706701, 1.7898425538195462, 0.5606123756506538, -0.5360178550762726], Float64[0.2786557180900429, 0.0195374368245858, -0.16775114705876862, 0.5459016904898485]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  y_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_y); y_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_y[__trial])
  y_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_y)); y_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_y[__trial]))
  x_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_x); x_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_x[__trial])
  x_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_x)); x_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_x[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_prefixscan_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_prefixscan_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = prefixscan_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, y_val_cpu, y_sh_cpu, x_val_cpu, x_sh_cpu, n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = prefixscan_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, y_val_gpu, y_sh_gpu, x_val_gpu, x_sh_gpu, n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()

  local_max = 0.0

  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(y_sh_cpu, Array(y_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(y_val_cpu, Array(y_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(x_sh_cpu, Array(x_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(x_val_cpu, Array(x_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
